capabilities: create multi-column layouts with a [!cols] callout
set column ratios via the callout title
set the column gap via the callout title
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README covers only basic usage and the two title options (ratios and gap).
problem: Obsidian callouts and Markdown have no built-in way to arrange content side by side in multiple columns within a note.
summary: Callout-based plugin that creates multi-column layouts in notes using a [!cols] callout with columns separated by +++ markers.
